---
mode: agent
description: Wire up TLS config for the REST API or Kafka client
---

Configure TLS for: ${input:target:"the REST API (HTTPS)" or "the Kafka producer/consumer client"}

Follow the TLS conventions in copilot-instructions.md:

- For the REST API: configure `server.ssl.*` properties in
  `application.yml` pointing at the keystore in `docker/certs/`
  (generated by `scripts/generate-certs.sh`), sourced from env vars
  with local-dev defaults. Confirm the app fails to start with a
  clear error if the keystore is missing, rather than silently
  falling back to plaintext.
- For Kafka: configure `spring.kafka.properties.security.protocol=SSL`
  (or `SASL_SSL` if auth is also in scope) plus
  `ssl.truststore.location` / `ssl.keystore.location` and their
  password env vars, in the same `kafka.ssl` block used elsewhere.
- Never disable hostname verification
  (`ssl.endpoint.identification.algorithm=`) — if you think it's
  needed for local dev, stop and ask me first instead of just
  doing it.
- Add a short note to the README on which env vars need to be set
  and how they map to the generated cert files.
